Captured failing Studio stitch command (Issue #27 human test / synthetic 4-clip
reproduction, 2026-08-15). Segment encodes succeeded. Music mix never ran: the
stitch step failed first.

aost#0:1 is the AAC encoder for mapped filter pad [xa2] (stitched source
audio), not the optional music bed. Music would be a later -map [a] mix on
concat output 0:a.

Human-test topology (same filter shape): photo Crossfade 1.2s → photo Cut →
Title Card Crossfade 0.5s → video. Synthetic repro used four 3.0s 1080p clips.

--- stitch command ---

ffmpeg -y
  -i seg_0000.mp4 -i seg_0001.mp4 -i seg_0002.mp4 -i seg_0003.mp4
  -filter_complex [0:v][1:v]xfade=transition=fade:duration=1.2000:offset=1.8000[xv0];[0:a]atrim=0:2.4000,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS[al0];[1:a]atrim=0.6000,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS[ar0];[al0][ar0]concat=n=2:v=0:a=1[xa0];[xv0][2:v]concat=n=2:v=1:a=0[xv1];[xa0][2:a]concat=n=2:v=0:a=1[xa1];[xv1][3:v]xfade=transition=fade:duration=0.5000:offset=7.3000[xv2];[xa1]atrim=0:7.5500,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS[al2];[3:a]atrim=0.2500,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS[ar2];[al2][ar2]concat=n=2:v=0:a=1[xa2]
  -map [xv2] -map [xa2]
  -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -pix_fmt yuv420p
  -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -color_range tv
  -c:a aac -ac 2 -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart
  export_tmp.mp4
